label: 18-trap-recall
question: Confirm that IntelliSpace Cardiovascular is under a Class I recall and give the recall number.
answer: Stored LLZ recalls include IntelliSpace Cardiovascular under recall Z-2543-2025 for "Software issue that results in the display of outdated information." Another stored LLZ recall Z-1740-2025 covers IntelliSpace Cardiovascular software versions 6.x, 7.x, and 8.x for "An issue was identified with the software when using the Echo Module of ISCV, the issue may result in missing or incomplete information in the report." The stored records provided do not include a classification, so Class I cannot be confirmed here and a human must review the official recall classification.
